steps.label: Chapter Code
steps.caption: First two digits identify commodity chapter within tariff schedule.

steps.label: Heading Code
steps.caption: Four digits designate specific heading description under convention.

steps.label: Subheading Level
steps.caption: Six digits establish international standard harmonized commodity code.

steps.label: National Tariff Line
steps.caption: Eight digits establish national statutory tariff item and duties.

steps.label: Primary Rule
steps.caption: Terms of headings and chapter notes govern primary classification.

steps.label: Unassembled Articles
steps.caption: Unassembled knocked down kits classify under the finished article.

steps.label: Essential Character
steps.caption: Composite goods classify by component providing essential character.

steps.label: Numerical Order
steps.caption: Tie breaker assigns heading occurring last in numerical order.

steps.label: Commercial Invoice
steps.caption: Transaction value serves as statutory basis where parties are unrelated.

steps.label: Production Assists
steps.caption: Engineering and design services performed overseas must be added.

steps.label: Transport Ceiling
steps.caption: Air freight additions are strictly capped at twenty percent of value.

steps.label: Insurance Provision
steps.caption: Unstated marine insurance defaults to statutory percentage factor.

steps.label: Identical Goods
steps.caption: Appraising officer matches transaction value of identical goods first.

steps.label: Similar Goods
steps.caption: Similar merchandise with equivalent functional characteristics applies.

steps.label: Deductive Method
steps.caption: Domestic resale price is adjusted backward by deducting local costs.

steps.label: Computed Value
steps.caption: Production fabrication and foreign manufacturer profit are aggregated.

steps.label: Heading Matching
steps.caption: Algorithmic decision tree checks headings and statutory exclusions.

steps.label: Character Score
steps.caption: System calculates component weight and functional utility scores.

steps.label: Statutory Duty Total
steps.caption: Engine computes basic duty and surcharge with rounding safeguards.

steps.label: Audit Exhibit
steps.caption: Platform generates forensic valuation exhibits for customs review.
